gt_provenance.details: Accuracy uses GPT-5.4-generated gold answers judged by GPT-5.4. Same-model gold-and-judge setup. Behaviour rate is LLM-judge proxy. Not model-self-derived (judge evaluates DeepSeek outputs), but synthetic.

score_normalization.details: n_distinct is a count. Matched-rate accuracy is direct comparison. Preservation is baseline subtraction. No prediction-stat normalization.

result_existence.details: All C4 claims consistent with M4 result structure: n_distinct(steering)=4, n_distinct(prompt)=2, n_distinct(TI)=2 from controller summaries. Preservation miss (4pts vs 3pt floor) confirmed. Matched-rate comparison plausible from summary data.

dead_code.details: matched-rate pairing algorithm (pair controllers with rate diff <=2pts) not directly auditable from summary-level JSON. Per-task data needed for full verification.

scope.details: 60/500 tasks disclosed. Only uncertainty testable — disclosed. Preservation miss explicitly disclosed. TI_amplify wider range noted. No overclaiming.
